page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The x86_64 architecture includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, fall into the bottom 25% tier, reflecting the older CPU architecture. However, multi-core performance is average, placing in the middle 50% for multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth read and write speeds also perform within the average tier, though overall memory latency and efficiency tests show weaker relative performance.

Given the older Intel Xeon hardware profile, this instance offers a cost-efficient option for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core speeds or massive memory allocations. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it suitable for parallel processing tasks, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations. It is less suitable for memory-intensive databases or single-threaded legacy applications.
